name: MBathroom
tagline: Ratings and recommendations for campus bathrooms.

awards: MLH - Best AI Application presented by Cloudflare || Arduino Kit

problem: On a big campus students cannot compare bathrooms.
solution: A React site backed by a database on Cloudflare, using campus building data and maps for reviews and recommendations.
demo_moment: Team-described: find the best-rated bathroom nearby.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH - Best AI Application presented by Cloudflare || Arduino Kit” among 122 submissions.
A humorous, local problem everyone has.

lessons: A funny local problem wins attention and a sponsor prize.
